lines.zh: 我迈开步子，喊了一嗓子。
lines.en: I set off with a shout.
My red scarf streams in the wind.
I carry a microphone.
I run across the plain and the grass goes down.
I shout a slogan as I run.
My horns shine in the sun.
I run uphill without slowing.
I leap once and land solidly.
I run toward the cooking smoke.
I want everyone to hear me.
I step so loudly the birds scatter.
The birds are gone. I'm still shouting.

lines.zh: 我站着，麦克风举在嘴边。
lines.en: I stand with the mic at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我敲了敲麦克风，还有声。
lines.en: I tap the mic; it still sounds.
I test the sound.
That one was loud enough.
I nod, satisfied.
I count my horns.
Two. Both there.

lines.zh: 我把红围巾重新系了一下。
lines.en: I retie my red scarf.

lines.zh: 围巾角上，我缝了自己的名字。
lines.en: I sewed my own name into the corner of my scarf.

lines.zh: 麦克风电量还够，我试试音。
lines.en: The mic still has charge; I test my voice.
A good day for shouting.
I take a deep breath.

lines.zh: 我把麦克风换到另一只手。
lines.en: I switch the mic to my other hand.
My neck is a bit stiff.
That last one carried, didn't it?
The shouting is mine.
I'm here, shouting the whole time.
You've got your hands over your ears.
Covering them won't help.
I can go louder.
Want to shout something too?
Anything at all.
You feel better once you do.
I'll wait here for you.
You don't shout a word.
Then I'll go first.
Remember my name.
I'll say it again.
It doesn't matter if you forget.
I'll keep shouting.
I cry out, and my voice cracks.
I check the microphone.
The mic is still in my hand.

lines.zh: 高吼兽的麦克风被打歪。
lines.en: The shoutmon's microphone got knocked askew.
I hold my chest.

lines.zh: 麦克风上沾了我一口血。
lines.en: My blood smears the microphone.
I wipe it with the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 我手里这根麦，是我全部的家当。
lines.en: This mic in my hand is all I own.
I shout once more.
Louder than before.
Can you eat that?
I've run all morning. I'm hungry.
I've been running all morning.
I stop and stare at it.
You've set it on the ground.
I bite down and shake it twice.
Too fast. I choke.
I thump my chest.
That's gone down at last.
Where's the next mouthful?

lines.zh: 我举着麦克风，红围巾在风里飘。
lines.en: Mic raised, red scarf streaming in the wind.
After this I'm back to shouting.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，被撞开了。
lines.en: You hit me and are knocked back.
My footing slipped; I swayed twice.

lines.zh: 这一下，我们俩都有点懵。
lines.en: That dazed us both a little.
I straighten up first and pull you up.
Sorry. I was running too fast.

lines.zh: 我扶你起来，围巾扫到你脸。
lines.en: I pull you up and my scarf brushes your face.
That clap was too heavy.
I pat it instead.
I've left a hollow in the grass.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，被撞开了，对不起。
lines.en: You struck me and bounced off — I am sorry.

lines.zh: 我一直想找个人一起喊。
lines.en: I've always wanted someone to shout with.
Shouting alone, the echo sounds lonely.

lines.zh: 我在草原上喊过很多次。
lines.en: I've shouted across the plain many times.
No one answered on the plain.

lines.zh: 有一次，有个声音回来了。
lines.en: Once, a voice came back.
I ran over. It was a cliff.

lines.zh: 我对着岩壁又吼了一次。
lines.en: I roar at the rock wall once more.
Then I got used to it.
I go on shouting anyway.
The cliff keeps answering.
I pounce and pin it.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，先咬它的壳缝。
lines.en: I pounce and go for the seam in its shell.
The shell is too hard, so I push with my horn.
I flip it over with my teeth.
It's cracked open.
I carry it back behind the grass.
Two steps and it drops.
I turn back and pick it up.
I work my way back step by step.
I finish it under a tree root.
One extra footstep in the echo.
I raise the microphone.
I lift the microphone to my lips.
I shout out at it.
The sound hits the trees and bounces back.
It actually didn't run.
It stops and turns to face me.
Then I'll shout again.
This time I shout louder.
My voice shoves it back.
Good. That works.

lines.zh: 我踏前一步，草倒了一片。
lines.en: One step and the grass goes flat.
I shout and chase together.
It covers its ears.
Then I run at it.
I shout the first note at it.
I run and shout.
It falls back into the trees.
Trees block sound. They don't block me.
I charge in after it.
Branches rake my face.
Branches rake my face. I ignore them.
It hides behind a trunk.

lines.zh: 我踩着草，从后头包过去。
lines.en: I crash through the grass to cut behind.
It hides behind another.
This feels like a game.
I'm starting to enjoy it.
I shout even louder.
All the leaves come down.
It runs with its ears covered.

lines.zh: 我要当数码兽之王，先拿你练手。
lines.en: I'll be Digimon King; you're practice.
A few strides and I have it.
My mic doubles as a club.
My horns catch its chest.
One shout slides it three blocks back.
I shout again.
The sound drives it to the ground.
Three strides and I'm on it.
It raises an arm to block.
One butt and it's aside.

lines.zh: 它滚了两圈，火焰还没喷完。
lines.en: It rolled twice; the flame is still going.

lines.zh: 我的影子罩住它半个身子。
lines.en: My shadow covers half of its body.

lines.zh: 我把麦克风对着它耳朵。
lines.en: I point the microphone at its ear.

lines.zh: 我把麦克风递到它脸前。
lines.en: I push the mic up to its face.
I charge down off the grass slope.
Shouting as I run.
The plain is full of echoes.

lines.zh: 回音从草坡那边弹回来。
lines.en: The echo bounces back off the grassy slope.
My echo is still sounding.
That pleases me.
Good grass here. Good for running.
I tighten my red scarf.
The mic still has charge.
I test one note.

lines.zh: 我这一嗓子，惊起一群鸟。
lines.en: My one shout startles a flock of birds.
Good. It carries.
I run that way.
Maybe there's someone.
It'd be good if there were someone.
I can shout for them.

lines.zh: 火燎到围巾，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my scarf and I slap it out.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔得四脚朝天。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land on my back.
Water fills my mouth and I can't shout.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，麦克风飞了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and the mic flies off.

lines.zh: 我的麦克风被擦出一道痕。
lines.en: A scratch runs across my microphone.

lines.zh: 一道光罩住我，声音出不去。
lines.en: A light covers me and the sound can't get out.
I'm hungry and can't shout.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我的声音被盖住了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and drowns out my voice.
My shout drops into the blankness.
